evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Apply data governance practices, including data quality checks, metadata, lineage and business definitions, to ensure trusted and well-governed data products
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize governance, data quality, reliability, and production support with no velocity language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Experience within commodity trading, financial trading or complex international environments is considered a strong advantage
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The client's domain touches commodity/financial trading (a preferred-experience signal) but this isn't confirmed as the actual sector, and the JD language stays generic business-decision framing, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: to strengthen a growing Data & Analytics environment
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD explicitly describes a 'growing' data and analytics environment with an existing team of Data Engineers, indicating mid maturity.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain data pipelines by developing batch data ingestions and transforming raw data into analytics-ready datasets using SQL and Python (and dbt where applicable)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools and specific technical scope appear in responsibilities, but this is a recruiter/agency posting for an anonymized client with some generic phrasing, so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: translating business requirements into trusted, analytics-ready datasets, while building and maintaining reliable data pipelines that support data-driven decision-making across multiple business domains
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Primary focus is on delivering trusted, governed analytics-ready data products to internal business consumers, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own data products end-to-end, from gathering business requirements to managing stakeholders, prioritizing work and delivering trusted analytics solutions through to production support
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns data products end-to-end including stakeholder management and prioritization (strategic) while also executing pipeline builds and production support (execution), hence mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only vaguely ("large-scale analytics and AI initiatives", "rapidly evolving data & AI landscape") without any specific candidate skill expected, so none.
evidence.testing_framing: Apply data governance practices, including data quality checks, metadata, lineage and business definitions, to ensure trusted and well-governed data products
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality checks and governance are framed as an owned responsibility with an action verb ("Apply"), so responsibility.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Production support, monitoring and reliability are a clear secondary concern behind delivery, without explicit compliance/regulatory language, so moderate.
